svg.title: The Great River
svg.desc: The river flows south from Sarn Gebir, through the Argonath into Nen Hithoel. Amon Hen is on the west bank, Amon Lhaw on the east; Rauros is below the lake. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: Sarn Gebir · the Argonath · Nen Hithoel
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
